From e46b5a6470a5e2c8e1096f8f60887ac19949055b Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Shawn Guo <shawn.guo@linaro.org>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2015 22:06:41 +0800
Subject: [PATCH] ARM: dts: fix imx27 dtb build rule

The i.MX27 dtb build should be controlled by CONFIG_SOC_IMX27 rather
than CONFIG_SOC_IMX31.

Signed-off-by: Shawn Guo <shawn.guo@linaro.org>
Fixes: cb612390e546 ("ARM: dts: Only build dtb if associated Arch and/or SoC is enabled")
Cc: <stable@vger.kernel.org>

diff --git a/arch/arm/boot/dts/Makefile b/arch/arm/boot/dts/Makefile
index 86217db2937a..992736b5229b 100644
--- a/arch/arm/boot/dts/Makefile
+++ b/arch/arm/boot/dts/Makefile
@@ -223,7 +223,7 @@ dtb-$(CONFIG_SOC_IMX25) += \
 	imx25-eukrea-mbimxsd25-baseboard-dvi-vga.dtb \
 	imx25-karo-tx25.dtb \
 	imx25-pdk.dtb
-dtb-$(CONFIG_SOC_IMX31) += \
+dtb-$(CONFIG_SOC_IMX27) += \
 	imx27-apf27.dtb \
 	imx27-apf27dev.dtb \
 	imx27-eukrea-mbimxsd27-baseboard.dtb \
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `arch/arm/boot/dts/Makefile`**
   - The line that previously added device tree blobs (dtbs) for the i.MX31 SoC has been changed to associate them with the i.MX27 SoC instead. Specifically, the line:
     ```makefile
     dtb-$(CONFIG_SOC_IMX31) += \
     ```
     has been replaced with:
     ```makefile
     dtb-$(CONFIG_SOC_IMX27) += \
     ```

### Relationships
- The modification in the `Makefile` corrects the build rule for the i.MX27 device tree blobs, ensuring that they are built when the configuration option `CONFIG_SOC_IMX27` is enabled, rather than `CONFIG_SOC_IMX31`. This change addresses a bug introduced in a previous commit (cb612390e546) that incorrectly linked the i.MX27 dtb build to the i.MX31 configuration.

The bug was caused by an incorrect association in the device tree blob (dtb) build rules, where the i.MX27 dtbs were mistakenly linked to the configuration option for the i.MX31 SoC instead of the correct i.MX27 option.
